verdict.rationale: Supermemory ingests raw conversations and extracts memories from them automatically. It can update an ongoing conversation by `customId`, processing only the new content. Its auto-maintained user profiles and hybrid search give an agent the prior context it needs to carry on. However, nothing in the evidence describes generating explicit summaries of a past session or thread; continuity comes from extracted facts and retrieval, not a session-summary artifact. Missing for 10: an explicit session/thread summary endpoint or feature, documented per-session retrieval to resume a specific thread, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
